During the [[Clone Wars]],<ref name="DV GP1" /> between [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] and [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="Clone Wars Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' establishes the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] took place between the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] and [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mirak Major]] was '''evacuated''' by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] under the leadership of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Gentis]] after the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], the Republic's adversary during the Clone Wars, triggered the sudden eruption of the planet's [[mega-volcano]]es. Due to the actions of Gentis, six billion individuals were safely rescued from the calamity.<ref name="DV GP1" />

In 19 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|BBY]],<ref name="VaderDate">The various ''Darth Vader'' miniseries released by [[Dark Horse Comics]] date themselves to a few [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the events of [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Revenge of the Sith'']], which ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' dates to early in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], thus placing the ''Darth Vader'' comics, including ''[[Star Wars: Darth Vader and the Ghost Prison]]'', in 19 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|BBY]] as well.</ref> following the Clone Wars, valedictorian [[Laurita Tohm]] and hundreds of other [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Officer/Legends|officers]] listened to [[Headmaster/Legends|Headmaster]] Gentis on<ref name="DV GP1" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] planet<ref name="CatCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] as they graduated from their corresponding academies. There, Tohm recollected Gentis' actions on Mirak Major as the [[Gender/Legends|man]] spoke.<ref name="DV GP1" />

==Behind the scenes==
The evacuation of Mirak Major was mentioned in the [[Darth Vader and the Ghost Prison 1|first issue]] of the [[2012]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] miniseries ''[[Star Wars: Darth Vader and the Ghost Prison]]''. The comic was written by [[W. Haden Blackman]] and published by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="DV GP1" /> on [[May 23]], 2012.<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54120/star_wars_darth_vader_and_the_ghost_prison_2012_1|text=Star Wars: Darth Vader and the Ghost Prison (2012) #1}}</ref>
